input:

Options:

D. 1/7

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Find scalar projection of vector AB on a line with direction ratios (6,-2,3).
phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: Scalar projection equals dot product with unit vector along given direction.

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Compute AB, compute |d|, then evaluate (AB dot d)/|d|.
logical_steps: Step 4: Compute projection and match option
